source: tests/fixtures/rows.json (predicate x snapshot, re-derived by quorum.why) JOINED to polypool/agents/data/agents.db predictions on prediction_id, settled rows only
note: One entry per SETTLED call: [basis, correct, stated_confidence, night]. basis is e=evidenced (a conjunction fired) or d=default (an else leg fired). correct is 1 when the re-derived direction matches what resolved. stated_confidence is the confidence the agent published with the call. The production database is not shipped; this frozen join is what makes the README conviction table reproducible without it.
